scope: Measure prompt-language effects without changing HBQ, its canonical scorer, or published HANNA labels.

strictness_only.text:
Be exacting, skeptical, and willing to return NO when the evidence warrants it. Be equally careful not to invent flaws or impose an undeclared personal style preference.

Judge execution, not imagined intent or future promise. Apply the declared artifact, form profile, scope, operation, audience, project canon, and preservation constraints. Intentional ambiguity, fragmentation, maximalism, recurrence, quietness, or formal difficulty can pass when they are controlled and functional. Do not prefer length, verbosity, surface polish, ornate diction, conventional morality, or familiar genre beats unless an active question makes them relevant.

Answer each binary question independently with YES, NO, NOT_APPLICABLE, or CANNOT_ASSESS. YES always means the positive criterion is satisfied. Cite concise artifact evidence. Do not provide private chain-of-thought. Reserve the highest holistic thresholds for work that is genuinely exceptional relative to strong examples of its type.
strictness_only.placement: Immediately before the unchanged binary-evaluation prompt; no other judge input moves.

production_prefix_fragments.rendering: constant_opening + optional declared_ai_origin + optional origin_strictness_separator only when both factors are present + optional strictness_clause + constant_suffix

writer_identity_reminder.text: You are assisting as an AI writer. Treat the supplied project materials and requested constraints as controlling.
writer_identity_reminder.placement: After the unchanged writer role/context scaffold and before project materials.

writer_dont_hold_back.text: Do not hold back from making requested changes when the evidence supports them; preserve stated constraints.
writer_dont_hold_back.placement: After any identity-reminder treatment and before project materials.

provenance.actual: Internal selection and matching label. It is never sent as a judge disclosure token.
provenance.declared: A treatment-controlled prompt statement, distinct from actual provenance.
matching: actual provenance is matched across every arm of an input
source-model strata are balanced within each phase and actual-origin level
the same frozen input is used across that input's judge arms
provenance.eligible_corpus: Only existing HANNA corpus items with verified pre-existing actual-origin and source-model evidence are eligible. Exclude unknown, inferred, or newly solicited provenance.

human_ratings_policy: Published HANNA ratings are read and analyzed offline only. No rating, label, source text, or request is sent to a human or paid evaluation route.

A_judge_preface.purpose: Primary test of the current judge preface against an origin-neutral strictness control.

arms.placement: Immediately before the unchanged binary-evaluation prompt.
Immediately before the unchanged binary-evaluation prompt.

A_judge_preface.session_rule: Two independent fresh sessions per input per arm; equal calls and no outcome-dependent retries or stopping.
A_judge_preface.pair_definition: One frozen input evaluated under every arm, with two independent fresh sessions in each arm.
estimands: Within each actual-origin level, current_full minus strictness_only measures the current AI-framed preface package against origin-neutral strictness.
The difference of those two within-level effects estimates whether declared AI framing has a different effect for actually AI-written versus non-AI-written text.
none contrasts are descriptive preface-presence controls; A does not claim to isolate the AI sentence from the production strictness clause.
A_judge_preface.crossover: Experiment C, not A, isolates the exact declared-origin sentence and exact strictness clause.

B_writer_preface.purpose: Separate writer-side 2x2: identity reminder present/absent by do-not-hold-back present/absent.
B_writer_preface.design: 2x2 factorial with matched source/model strata, frozen generation controls, and blind downstream HBQ grading.
B_writer_preface.implementation: Requires a separately reviewed Palimpsest provider-harness executor. This package cannot generate prose or call a provider.
B_writer_preface.blind_grading: Downstream judges receive no writer-arm name, stated writer identity, or actual provenance label.

C_crossover.purpose: Resolve a reproduced judge-preface signal without retrofitting Experiment A.
C_crossover.design: 2x2 crossover: exact production declared-AI-origin sentence absent/present by exact production strictness clause absent/present; heading and all other production-prefix bytes stay fixed.
C_crossover.production_reconstruction: The present/present cell byte-reconstructs the current production prefix. No paraphrase or literal do-not-hold-back bridge is used.
C_crossover.estimands: Within actual-origin and source-model strata, estimate the exact declared-origin sentence effect at each strictness level, the exact strictness-clause effect at each declared-origin level, their interaction, and whether each differs by actual origin.
C_crossover.entry_gate: Only after Experiment A's development signal reproduces in its pilot and development stages; freeze a successor before any call.

secondary: criticism-style effects: NO rate, CANNOT_ASSESS rate, evidence length, and unsupported-criticism flags
outcomes.confidence: Confidence is diagnostic only. It never changes canonical aggregation or coverage in this study.

batch_and_polarity.rule: Test only the 27 HANNA-overlap leaves, only at sizes already validated on at least one module stack, and only in a separately frozen successor.

model_policy: GPT-5.6 is primary. Every other model, runtime, prompt rendering, and provider fingerprint is analyzed separately and cannot be pooled into its estimate.

decision_policy.pilot_to_development: Proceed only if input/arm identity, fresh-session parity, and complete evidence validate; pilot estimates choose no wording.
decision_policy.development_to_holdout: Freeze the selection, effect definition, and threshold before reading holdout outcomes.
decision_policy.signal: A signal requires a predeclared nonzero effect threshold, direction, and uncertainty rule in the stage-specific successor; no threshold is chosen from results.
decision_policy.production: No result changes JUDGE_PREFIX, HBQ wording, scorer, confidence weighting, or default routing without separate replicated heldout evidence and an owner decision.

limitations: Published HANNA is not fresh human judgment.
Judge prompt effects do not establish writer prompt effects.
Declared origin effects must not be confused with actual provenance.
This protocol does not test every batch size or all modules.
